propositions: A commit whose subject exceeds 50 characters or body line exceeds 72 characters must be rejected locally, with output naming each offending line and its length.
Gerrit's commit-msg hook that stamps Change-Id must be preserved in migration mode (commit-msg.legacy) and not clobbered when pre-commit installs the new commit-message-wrap hook.
Body lines must be exempt from the 72-character check if they match trailer, TAG, fenced code block, indented literal block (4+ spaces or tab), table row, or atomic token patterns as specified.
The checker must not mutate the commit message; git scaffolding (comment lines and --verbose diff) must produce no false positives.
The make hooks target must verify both pre-commit and commit-msg hook files are present post-install, warn if no Change-Id stamping is found, and exit non-zero on missing hooks.
